content.text:
terms_data_protection in columns: false
terms_data_storage in columns:    false
set terms_data_protection OK
set all terms OK
valid?: true

observation.command:
cd /workspace && export PATH=/usr/local/ruby/bin:/opt/node/bin:$PATH PGPASSWORD=root && timeout 200 bin/rails runner '
puts "terms_data_protection in columns: #{User.column_names.include?("terms_data_protection")}"
puts "terms_data_storage in columns:    #{User.column_names.include?("terms_data_storage")}"
u = User.new(username:"probe", email:"probe@consul.dev", password:"Aa12345678", password_confirmation:"Aa12345678", confirmed_at: Time.current, gender:"male", date_of_birth: 30.years.ago)
begin
  u.terms_data_protection = "1"; puts "set terms_data_protection OK"
rescue=>e; puts "set terms_data_protection => #{e.class}: #{e.message}"; end
begin
  u.terms_data_storage = "1"; u.terms_general = "1"; puts "set all terms OK"
rescue=>e; puts "set terms => #{e.class}: #{e.message}"; end
begin
  puts "valid?: #{u.valid?}"
  u.errors.full_messages.each { |m| puts "  ERR: #{m}" }
rescue=>e; puts "valid? => #{e.class}: #{e.message}"; end
' 2>&1 | tail -20
